text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the city――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright! After the crepe stand, it's off 
to the convenience store... Ten minutes 
till my shift starts, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... Since we're here, I'd like to kill 
time with some training, but... Hrmm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! Perfect timing! Um, only if you 
happen to know, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you know of any... workout routines 
that only take 10 minutes...?
choice_data_list: When in doubt, go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! True that! Instead of agonizing 
over it, I'm better off just running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Checking my form! That didn't even 
cross my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I haven't done those 
basic drills lately, have I... Yep, all 
right!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! For giving me advice. 
I'll go check it out right away.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
――And before we do that, I've got some 
great news for a kind soul like you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I recommend stopping by that crepe shop on 
Mondays! ...As thanks, I'll give you a 
nice little discount♪
